parameters.query:
SELECT day, source, jobs_seen, jobs_matched, applications_sent
FROM daily_metrics
WHERE day = CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY source;

SELECT j.source, j.title, j.company, j.url, j.posted_at, m.score, m.summary
FROM jobs j
JOIN match_results m ON m.job_id = j.id
WHERE j.discovered_at >= CURRENT_DATE
  AND m.score >= 70
ORDER BY m.score DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT a.id, j.title, j.company, j.source, a.status, a.submitted_at
FROM applications a
JOIN jobs j ON j.id = a.job_id
WHERE a.submitted_at >= CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY a.submitted_at DESC;
